description: Transition your toddler from crib to bed with this Newport toddler bed conversion kit. Designed specifically for the Newport crib, this kit makes the switch easy and safe. Features solid hardwood construction with Newport's signature BrownMaple finish. Includes all necessary hardware for quick assembly.
